help: edit starts from the received message and applies the operations. keep_only starts from an empty object: only the fields that set and copy write are output, copy reading the received message.
message edits the whole message. each_item edits every element of a JSON array, in order, and outputs the edited array; paths are then relative to each element.
Where the array is in the message, with the path syntax of operations. Leave empty when the message itself is the array.
Largest array accepted, from 1 to 10000. A longer array fails the activation; it is never truncated.
When the source of copy, rename or remove, or a template reference, does not resolve: skip leaves that operation out (a trace says so); fail stops the activation.
auto parses text that is valid JSON and keeps other text as a JSON string; always requires JSON; never keeps the received text as a JSON string (message only).
fail stops the activation without publishing anything; route publishes a JSON error document on error instead, and nothing on out. A partial result is never published.
